```{r}
#____Visualization of data by ggplot2_____

library(fpp)
library(fpp2)
library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)

#__Time series plot of a1o default data file of fpp2 package
data(a10)
a10
#__Using autoplot function under ggplot2
#__By which make time series plot___
# help("autoplot")
autoplot(a10)+
  ggtitle("Antidiabetic drug sales")+
  ylab("$ Million")+
  xlab("Year")

#____Seasonal plot using ggseasonplot___
ggseasonplot(a10,year.labels = T,year.labels.left = T)+
  ggtitle("Seasonal Plot: Antidiabetic drug sales")+
  ylab("$ Million ")+
  xlab("Year")

#_____Polar seasonal plot_____
ggseasonplot(a10,polar =T)+
  ggtitle("Polar Plot: Antidiabetic drug sales")+
  ylab("$ Million ")+
  xlab("Year")

#_____seasonal sub-series plot______
ggsubseriesplot(a10)+
  ggtitle("Sub-Series plot:Antidiabetic drug sales")+
  ylab('$ Million')

#_____Visualizing ausbeer default data file from fpp package_____
data("ausbeer")
ausbeer
beer2=window(ausbeer,start=1993,end=c(2006,4))
autoplot(beer2)

#____________Now forecast using descriptive method________
#_________Simple forecasting methods:___________
# Average 
# Naive(work with most recent values)
# Seasonal Naive
# Drift

beerfit1=meanf(beer2,h=12)
beerfit2=rwf(beer2,h=12)
beerfit3=snaive(beer2,h=12)

#____Plot these 3 forecasted value with original data together__
#_________plot full data set___________
autoplot(window(ausbeer,start=1992))+
  autolayer(beerfit1,series="Mean",PI=F)+
  autolayer(beerfit2,series="Naive",PI=F)+
  autolayer(beerfit3,series="Seasonal Naive",PI=F)+
  xlab("Year")+ylab("Megalitres")+
  ggtitle("Forecasted quarterly beer production")+
  guides(colour=guide_legend(title = "Forecast"))

# we see from graphical representation that seasonal naive method shows
# best performance for forecasting.Now we can check statistically
# To do this we take data stating with/from 2008 and take residual
# check out residual based measure of accuracy

#_______Accuracy________
beer3=window(ausbeer,start=2008)
accuracy(beerfit1,beer3)
accuracy(beerfit2,beer3)
accuracy(beerfit3,beer3)

#_______Final selection____
autoplot(beerfit3)

#_________Another data____________
goog200
autoplot(goog200)

#_________Forecast for next 40_______
googf1=meanf(goog200,h=40)
googf2=rwf(goog200,h=40)
googf3=rwf(goog200,drift=T,h=40)

autoplot(subset(goog200,end = 240))+
  autolayer(googf1,series="Mean",PI=F)+
  autolayer(googf2,series="Naive",PI=F)+
  autolayer(googf3,series="Drift",PI=F)+
  xlab("Day")+ylab("Closing price(us$")+
  ggtitle("Google Stock Price")+
  guides(colour=guide_legend(title = "Forecast"))
autoplot(googf3)


```
